title: Scatterplot of Runtime Against Rating
text:

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films['runtime_min'], films['imdb_rating'])









Figure 1: Runtime against rating







films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)

title: Revenue of Bond Films
text:
Plot

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films['franchise'] == "James Bond"]


plt.plot(bond['year'], bond['revenue_musd'])

firstyr = min(bond['year'])
lastyr = max(bond['year'])







Figure 1: Bond Films’ Revenue





The first Bond year is ‘{python} int(firstyr)’. The last Bond year is ‘{python} int(lastyr)’.
